lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast gradient with peak luminance on the superior edge and a shadow-induced lower intensity on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary biological entity (commensal organism) visible beneath the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
